subject.title: feat(plugins): deliver sessions.changed to plugin services

question: Should `sessions.changed` become a permanent public plugin-service SDK contract, with the proposed process-local payload and lifecycle semantics, rather than keeping ClickClack on plugin-local reconciliation?
rationale: This is a new documented cross-plugin API surface; repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction rather than inferring the permanent contract from one bundled plugin’s need.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow facade
options.body: Accept this typed event as the supported plugin-service seam, retaining feature detection and cleanup semantics, after real ClickClack proof is attached.

options.title: Defer the public SDK addition
options.body: Keep ClickClack’s existing fallback reconciliation and revisit the event only with a broader plugin-event contract proposal.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow facade
recommendation.body: Accept this typed event as the supported plugin-service seam, retaining feature detection and cleanup semantics, after real ClickClack proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the related merged ClickClack work and authored the proposed SDK and service integration.
